cc:Work.dc:title: Figure S3 localization and occlusion
cc:Work.dc:description: Fig. S3. Landmark localization and substantial-occlusion performance in 242 internal-validation images. (A) Clean-image radial error at P1–P5, measured relative to the mean of the available rater coordinates. (B) Mean radial error under clean inputs and nominal 30% occlusion. The same stored inputs are used for both decoders; dropout is disabled and BatchNorm statistics are estimated from training images. Whiskers show image-bootstrap 95% CIs. Panel y-scales differ. Table S4 retains the blur and speckle results. The separate 3% hip-region protocol in main Fig. 3 uses a different placement rule; the 3% and 30% conditions do not form a controlled occlusion-intensity series.
